content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm trying to locate the manual for [article_no]. Any assistance would be welcome.
Is it currently an [article_no] rather than an [article_no]? Is there a particular reason you're searching for the [article_no] manual?
You can find manuals for all [product_name] devices at [document].
I have three [article_no] extension modules installed on this machine. There's a sliding switch on the input side, and I'd like to understand its function better.
This slider establishes a connection for the bus between the base module and other extension modules.
Here is a section from the manual of [article_no].
If I stop [product_name], should the RUN/STOP LEDs on the extension modules turn red? I notice they remain green even when I stop [product_name].

A green RUN/STOP LED shows that the base module is communicating with the extension module, regardless of whether it's stopped or running. If the LED is red, the base module isn't communicating with the extension module. Yellow means the extension module is being initialized.

Detailed explanations of hardware indicators are requested, highlighting a gap in knowledge about extension module operations.

They want easy-to-use documentation and direct guidance regarding hardware indicators and functionality.
